item.title: In a first, Rafales take on China's J-16 fighters; why India is watching closely
item.summary: Chinese J-16 fighter jets engaged Egyptian Rafale aircraft in simulated air combat. This exercise provided China rare training against a Western fighter type. The PLA Air Force gained valuable data on Rafale capabilities and tactical behavior. India is closely monitoring this development as it involves a similar fighter. This encounter offers China insights for potential future air engagements.
